limits: No real fleet cleanup, deployment, worker restart, increased capacity or merge.
Remote reclamation covers only redundant input.tar for FINISHED/PASSED/COMPLETE/CONFIRMED; all source/profile/temp/capture/log/state evidence retained.
Requires supported POSIX descriptor-relative no-follow operations and hard links, and private cooperating queue-directory ownership; no arbitrary same-account mutation isolation.
16 GiB per-file hash bound and cooperative 30-second budget; a blocked filesystem operation can exceed it and the host lock is held.
Logical bytes are not guaranteed physical reclaimed capacity; backup hard links may be counted per path by size inventories.
No local attempt, shared-cache, snapshot, old-pending or failed/UNKNOWN job sweep; no atomic volume reservations or complete collection transaction.
Archive build now precedes receipt/host reservation, but remote upload/request ambiguity remains. Unremovable owned temporaries block repeated automatic rebuilds.
New local pool placement needs worker storage telemetry; old/unavailable telemetry is DISK_UNKNOWN, not permission to restart active ownership.
Executing-loop storage failure can still enter teardown; independent guardian continuity remains open.
